name: Weaviate
label: Weaviate — objects and GraphQL search
description: Official Weaviate REST + GraphQL at http://localhost:8080. collection.insert POST /v1/objects; collection.getMany GET /v1/objects; collection.query and collection.hybrid POST /v1/graphql; collection.deleteByClass DELETE /v1/objects/{class}/{id} (current). collection.delete DELETE /v1/objects/{id} is deprecated by Weaviate. Auth Bearer api_key. Customer owns the cluster. Never log api_key. Docs: https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/api/rest.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"collection.getMany","class":"Article","limit":10}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: collection.insert | collection.getMany | collection.query | collection.hybrid | collection.delete | collection.deleteByClass. collection.delete is deprecated (DELETE /v1/objects/{id}); prefer collection.deleteByClass. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Do not put api_key here. Example: 'collection.getMany'.

schema.label: class
schema.description: Collection/class name. insert, getMany, deleteByClass. Example: Article.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Official Weaviate object properties map for collection.insert. Keys are class property names. Example: {"title":"Hello","body":"…"}. https://weaviate.io/developers/weaviate/api/rest#tag/objects/POST/v1/objects

schema.label: id
schema.description: Object UUID. Path on collection.delete and collection.deleteByClass; optional on insert.

schema.label: vector
schema.description: Optional vector list for collection.insert when not using a vectorizer.

schema.label: tenant
schema.description: Multi-tenant collection tenant name (insert body; query param on getMany/delete).

schema.label: query
schema.description: GraphQL query document for collection.query / collection.hybrid POST /v1/graphql.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: collection.insert | collection.getMany | collection.query | collection.hybrid | collection.delete | collection.deleteByClass. collection.delete is deprecated.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Weaviate API key. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Cloud Console or AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_ALLOWED_KEYS.

configurationParameters.label: Base URL
configurationParameters.description: Weaviate server origin including scheme and port, no trailing slash. Self-hosted default http://localhost:8080; Weaviate Cloud uses the cluster REST endpoint. Example: https://my-cluster.c0.europe-west3.gcp.weaviate.cloud.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
